claims.answer: Pricing displays dollar amounts: current Basic$5/month with$9 struck through, Pro$20/month, and Lifetime$120 once with$180 struck through. The inspected text does not explicitly name USD; no USD bucket is proposed. Basic and Pro are monthly access plans; Lifetime is a one-time local-feature license. Basic/Lifetime amounts are displayed alongside struck-through prior prices. Basic/Pro include a managed-model allowance; Lifetime uses users own provider keys. Terms say allowances may change and are not unlimited. Model/provider charges remain distinct from the ADE fee. Machines uses a Linux server/VPS the user already pays for. No server/compute price is quoted.
